correctness.rationale: Monomial orthogonality, unit-sphere normalization and gamma–Dirichlet representation were reconstructed. Strict Poisson survival log-concavity follows from a monotone ratio of explicit positive tail sums, yielding unique minimizing pure-rival powers; strict gamma coupling yields unique maximizing selected pure power. The endpoint values follow by inclusion-exclusion and exchangeability, and the exponential limit follows from the first nonconstant term. The checker passes all 32 finite endpoint spectra with exact arithmetic and nine independent 65-digit quadratures. Finite checks are diagnostics, not the infinite proof.

The exact full spectrum, unique top mode, k-1-dimensional worst-mode space and universal 2^(m+1) leading condition growth answer the natural observation/recovery question and explain the severe degree-driven instability of this geometric partition. This is a structurally motivated sharp invariant, not an arbitrary finite tabulation.
